h1: Custom Unisex School Kits for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Unisex School Kits - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex school kits in bulk for your school or business. Perfect Imprints offers reliable branding and fast delivery.
introHtml: Unisex school kits work for any student, making them a practical choice for schools, nonprofits, and corporate donation programs. These kits typically include gender-neutral items like notebooks, pens, and a backpack or drawstring bag. By choosing unisex, you simplify inventory and ensure every recipient gets a useful kit. Decorate with screen-printed logos or foil-stamped covers for a professional finish that appeals to all ages.
heroAltText: Custom unisex school kits with notebooks, pens, and a drawstring bag, all branded with a company logo.
